question: What is the most awkward case of mistaken identity you have been in?
story: I sat through an entire wedding reception before I realized I did not know a single person in the room. I was twenty three. A friend texted me a hotel name and a time, so I put on a suit and drove forty minutes. Second floor ballroom. I walked in, found my name printed on a card at table nine, and sat down. My actual name. That is why I never asked questions. I ate the chicken. I clapped for a toast about a man named Doug. I danced. Then a woman asked how I knew the bride, and I said we went to school together, which is when I learned the bride's name was Priya. My friend's wedding was in the hotel across the street. Here is the part that still gets me. There was another guest with my exact name, and he never showed up. Two weeks later I got a thank you card.
